FX-KCLEAN-001.says: Key Cleaner as added: Additional Edge Radius 10, Alpha Contrast 0, Strength 100. Within 10 pixels of the matte's edge, on so small a drawing nearly all of it, the covering is fitted to the colours: the strands' covering follows their orange and teal rows, the rectangle's teal ring and right side lose some, and empty pixels near the matte gain a little, in the colours about them.

FX-KCLEAN-002.says: Additional Edge Radius 4: the fit is worked over smaller squares, so it follows the colours more closely.

FX-KCLEAN-003.says: Additional Edge Radius 0, Alpha Contrast 0: nothing to do, the output is the drawing.

FX-KCLEAN-004.says: Additional Edge Radius 4, Alpha Contrast 50: FX-KCLEAN-002's covering steepened, below a quarter gone and above three quarters full.

FX-KCLEAN-005.says: Additional Edge Radius 4, Alpha Contrast 100: every pixel full or empty, full where FX-KCLEAN-002's covering is above a half.

FX-KCLEAN-006.says: Additional Edge Radius 0, Alpha Contrast 50: no fit, only the part-covered pixels steepened: the strands and the half-covered right edge.

FX-KCLEAN-007.says: FX-KCLEAN-002 at Strength 50: halfway between the drawing and FX-KCLEAN-002, premultiplied.

FX-KCLEAN-008.says: Strength 0: the output is the drawing.

FX-KCLEAN-009.says: Additional Edge Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 4: whole pixels, so frame 1 (1.5) works at 1, frame 2 at 3 and frame 3 (4.5) at 4.

FX-KCLEAN-010.says: Strength keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: the drawing, then halfway at frame 2, then FX-KCLEAN-001.

FX-KCLEAN-011.says: FX-KCLEAN-001 moved three pixels right: worked in the drawing's own space, so the same, moved.

FX-KCLEAN-012.says: Additional Edge Radius 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KCLEAN-013.says: Additional Edge Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KCLEAN-014.says: Alpha Contrast 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KCLEAN-015.says: Alpha Contrast -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KCLEAN-016.says: Strength 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KCLEAN-017.says: Strength -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KCLEAN-018.says: Strength keyed to 101 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
